bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
cd "$root"
PYTHONPATH=scripts timeout 70s python3 - <<'PY'
import asyncio
from userbot_test_client import invoke
r=asyncio.run(invoke("bot_start_menu"))
print("LIVE_MENU_RESULT="+str(r.get("status","UNKNOWN")))
rows=r.get("row_sizes",[])
if isinstance(rows,list) and all(isinstance(x,int) and 0<=x<=20 for x in rows):
 print("LIVE_MENU_ROW_SIZES="+",".join(map(str,rows)))
else:
 print("LIVE_MENU_ROW_SIZES=UNAVAILABLE")
if r.get("menu_matches_contract") is True:
 print("LIVE_MENU_CONTRACT=PASS")
elif r.get("menu_matches_contract") is False:
 print("LIVE_MENU_CONTRACT=MISMATCH")
else:
 print("LIVE_MENU_CONTRACT=UNKNOWN")
PY
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
